entries.developer_comments: ~ Display name of a crafting requirement
~ Description of compact bionic module 'Exodii Cyberframe 1a'
identity: A bulky Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, will be encased in a solid metal core.  While there is clearly a head and torso, it is difficult to tell where one starts and the other ends.  It will be difficult or impossible to squeeze through tight spaces, or to wear normal-sized clothing and armor.  The frame greatly increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is highly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature, you will still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.

identity:
I'm not sure I should be writing this down but I'm definitely not putting it on the network.  Ever since the quarantine I've been able to pick up the occasional radio signal, mostly music, some news, some hobbyists.

Things are a lot worse than we're being told.  I keep hearing reports from preppers on the radio talking about rioters fighting police and the military with no regard for their safety, running screaming straight into gunfire.  And the reanimations are so widespread that they're happening basically everywhere.  Neither the police nor the military can keep up.

The brass have to know about this, so why aren't they telling us?  They're trying to maintain morale?  I have to keep practicing until I can send a signal to one of those preppers, tell them what I know.  Maybe something good can come from being stuck down here.
